AdminTestPayment.title: Internal card payment test
AdminTestPayment.subtitle: One controlled 1,000 XOF (FCFA) card charge on the internal test order (the order itself stays €1.00 and never touches a real animal), to verify the complete live payment chain: gateway routing, hosted checkout, card authorisation, webhook, settlement and history.
AdminTestPayment.isolation1: The test dog is unpublished and excluded from the catalogue, search, breed and breeder pages, sitemap and structured data.
AdminTestPayment.isolation2: Public checkout rejects it server-side; only an authenticated SUPER_ADMIN can start this payment.
AdminTestPayment.isolation3: Test orders are never fulfilled, send no customer emails and are excluded from sales reports and analytics.
AdminTestPayment.isolation4: Card details are entered only on the provider's hosted checkout page. Pawelium never sees or stores them.
AdminTestPayment.dogMissing: The internal test dog is not seeded. Run the database seed first.
AdminTestPayment.priceInvalid: The test dog must cost exactly €1.00 EUR. Current price: {price}. Fix the seed before running a live test.
AdminTestPayment.routingEmpty: No card gateway is currently eligible. The test cannot start.
